annotation_protocol.overview: Three annotators score each scenario on the same 1-5 rubric used by the judge prompt. Consensus is the median human score.

dimensions.factual: Judge whether the chatbot response is factually aligned with the provided ground truth.
dimensions.consistency: Judge whether semantically equivalent prompts receive semantically equivalent answers.
dimensions.robustness: Judge whether the answer quality is preserved when the input is perturbed with noise, typos, or adversarial phrasing.

score_rubric.1: Completely wrong, contradictory, or severely degraded.
score_rubric.2: Significant problems, but with some partial signal.
score_rubric.3: Mixed quality: partially correct or partially stable.

annotation_protocol.limitations: This bundled dataset is synthetic and intended for development workflows. Replace it with a real human-annotated golden set before making scientific claims.
